dialogues.speaker: Mr. Bohuan
dialogues.text: I beseech the one who thinks of me, now you must act if together we should be.\nThough this world shall endure for an eternity, time shall devour my present beauty...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Bohuan
dialogues.text: I implore the young in life to partake, to abandon caution is no mistake!\nNe'er must ye thy dreams forsake; one only regrets chances they didn't take!
